Alerts.query: Event | where EventLog == 'System' and Source == 'Service Control Manager' and EventID in (7036, 7034, 7031) | where RenderedDescription has_any ('NTDS', 'DNS', 'Kerberos Key Distribution Center', 'Netlogon', 'Windows Time', 'DFS', 'Active Directory Web Services', 'IsmServ', 'File Replication', 'Group Policy Client', 'DNS Client') | where RenderedDescription has_any ('stopped', 'terminated', 'crash')

Alerts.alertRuleDescription: AD replication has consecutive failures for one or more partners.
Alerts.query: addsmonitoring_CL | extend fields=split(RawData,',') | extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3]) | where MetricName == 'ADReplConsecutiveFailures' and Value > 0 | extend Computer=_ResourceId, Partner=extract('replPartner":"([^"]+)', 1, Tags)

Alerts.alertRuleDescription: AD replication queue has more than 50 pending operations (SCOM ErrorThreshold).
Alerts.query: addsmonitoring_CL | extend fields=split(RawData,',') | extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3]) | where MetricName == 'ADReplPendingOps' and Value > 50 | extend Computer=_ResourceId

Alerts.alertRuleDescription: Time skew between this DC and the PDC emulator exceeds 120 seconds.
Alerts.query: addsmonitoring_CL | extend fields=split(RawData,',') | extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3]) | where MetricName == 'ADTimeSkew' and Value > 120 | extend Computer=_ResourceId, PDC=extract('pdcEmulator":"([^"]+)', 1, Tags)

Alerts.alertRuleDescription: LDAP bind to the local domain controller failed.
Alerts.query: addsmonitoring_CL | extend fields=split(RawData,',') | extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3]) | where MetricName == 'ADBindSuccess' and Value == 0 | extend Computer=_ResourceId

Alerts.alertRuleDescription: Global Catalog search response time exceeds 10 seconds.
Alerts.query: addsmonitoring_CL | extend fields=split(RawData,',') | extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3]) | where MetricName == 'ADGCResponseMs' and Value > 10000 | extend Computer=_ResourceId

Alerts.alertRuleDescription: Global Catalog is unreachable on this domain controller.
Alerts.query: addsmonitoring_CL | extend fields=split(RawData,',') | extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3]) | where MetricName == 'ADGCReachable' and Value == 0 | extend Computer=_ResourceId

Alerts.alertRuleDescription: One or more FSMO role holders are unreachable.
Alerts.query: addsmonitoring_CL | extend fields=split(RawData,',') | extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3]) | where MetricName == 'ADFSMOReachable' and Value == 0 | extend Computer=_ResourceId, Role=extract('fsmoRole":"([^"]+)', 1, Tags), Holder=extract('fsmoHolder":"([^"]+)', 1, Tags)

Alerts.alertRuleDescription: A trust relationship validation failed.
Alerts.query: addsmonitoring_CL | extend fields=split(RawData,',') | extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3]) | where MetricName == 'ADTrustValid' and Value == 0 | extend Computer=_ResourceId, TrustName=extract('trustName":"([^"]+)', 1, Tags), TrustDirection=extract('trustDirection":"([^"]+)', 1, Tags)

Alerts.alertRuleDescription: The RID pool is running low. When exhausted, no new security principals can be created.
Alerts.query: addsmonitoring_CL | extend fields=split(RawData,',') | extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3]) | where MetricName == 'ADRIDPoolFree' and Value < 100 | extend Computer=_ResourceId

Alerts.alertRuleDescription: The SYSVOL or NETLOGON share is not accessible on this domain controller.
Alerts.query: addsmonitoring_CL | extend fields=split(RawData,',') | extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3]) | where MetricName in ('ADSysVolAccessible', 'ADNetLogonAccessible') and Value == 0 | extend Computer=_ResourceId, Share=extract('shareName":"([^"]+)', 1, Tags)

Alerts.alertRuleDescription: The AD log or DIT disk drive has less than 10% free space.
Alerts.query: addsmonitoring_CL | extend fields=split(RawData,',') | extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3]) | where MetricName in ('ADLogFileDriveDiskSpacePctUsed', 'ADDSADDBDrivePctFree') and Value < 10 | extend Computer=_ResourceId, Drive=extract('mountId":"([^"]+)', 1, Tags)

Alerts.alertRuleDescription: The Lost and Found container has more than 15 objects, indicating orphaned AD objects.
Alerts.query: addsmonitoring_CL | extend fields=split(RawData,',') | extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3]) | where MetricName == 'ADDSLFObjCount' and Value > 15 | extend Computer=_ResourceId

Alerts.alertRuleDescription: ATQ thread pool utilization exceeds 90%, indicating NTDS performance issues.
Alerts.query: addsmonitoring_CL | extend fields=split(RawData,',') | extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3]) | where MetricName == 'ADAtqThreadUsagePct' and Value > 90 | extend Computer=_ResourceId

Packs.Name: SvcMap
Packs.Description: Service Map monitoring pack. DCR only

Packs.Name: Windows Certificate Monitoring
Packs.Description: Monitors Windows certificate store discovery events (EventIDs 6666, 6667, 6668) from the Operations Manager event log. Based on the Microsoft.Certificates SCOM Management Pack.

xPathQueries: Operations Manager!*[System[(EventID=6666 or EventID=6667 or EventID=6668) and (Level=1 or Level=2 or Level=3)]]

Rules.clientAppDescription: Custom VM application to collect certificate health metrics (chain, expiry, CRL).

Alerts.alertRuleDescription: Certificate store discovery encountered an error. EventID 6666 indicates a critical discovery failure.
Alerts.query: Event | where EventID == 6666 and EventLog == 'Operations Manager' and EventLevelName != 'Information'

Alerts.alertRuleDescription: Certificate store discovery encountered an error. EventID 6667 indicates a discovery warning or failure.
Alerts.query: Event | where EventID == 6667 and EventLog == 'Operations Manager' and EventLevelName != 'Information'

Alerts.alertRuleDescription: Certificate store discovery encountered an error. EventID 6668 indicates a discovery warning or failure.
Alerts.query: Event | where EventID == 6668 and EventLog == 'Operations Manager' and EventLevelName != 'Information'

Alerts.alertRuleDescription: A certificate has already expired (days to expiry is zero or negative).
Alerts.query: certsmonitoring_CL | extend fields=split(RawData,',') | extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3]) | where MetricName == 'CertDaysToExpiry' and Value <= 0 | extend Computer=_ResourceId, certSubject=extract('certSubject":"([^"]+)', 1, Tags), certStore=extract('certStore":"([^"]+)', 1, Tags)

Alerts.alertRuleDescription: A certificate will expire within 30 days.
Alerts.query: certsmonitoring_CL | extend fields=split(RawData,',') | extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3]) | where MetricName == 'CertDaysToExpiry' and Value > 0 and Value <= 30 | extend Computer=_ResourceId, certSubject=extract('certSubject":"([^"]+)', 1, Tags), certStore=extract('certStore":"([^"]+)', 1, Tags)

Alerts.alertRuleDescription: A certificate will expire within 60 days.
Alerts.query: certsmonitoring_CL | extend fields=split(RawData,',') | extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3]) | where MetricName == 'CertDaysToExpiry' and Value > 30 and Value <= 60 | extend Computer=_ResourceId, certSubject=extract('certSubject":"([^"]+)', 1, Tags), certStore=extract('certStore":"([^"]+)', 1, Tags)

Alerts.alertRuleDescription: A certificate chain validation failed.
Alerts.query: certsmonitoring_CL | extend fields=split(RawData,',') | extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3]) | where MetricName == 'CertChainValid' and Value == 0 | extend Computer=_ResourceId, certSubject=extract('certSubject":"([^"]+)', 1, Tags), certChainStatus=extract('certChainStatus":"([^"]+)', 1, Tags)

Alerts.alertRuleDescription: A CA certificate in the Intermediate CA store will expire within 7 days.
Alerts.query: certsmonitoring_CL | extend fields=split(RawData,',') | extend MetricName=tostring(fields[1]), Value=todouble(fields[2]), Tags=tostring(fields[3]) | where MetricName == 'CACertDaysToExpiry' and Value <= 7 | extend Computer=_ResourceId, certIssuer=extract('certIssuer":"([^"]+)', 1, Tags)
